historic_survey.note: Named among the study area's civic and institutional resources as the Douglass School, opened to pupils in 1953 and funded through a $48 million school construction bond passed in 1948. It replaced the 1895 Douglass School on the same block, which local parents had been petitioning to have replaced since 1949.

historical_record.description: The morning after the White Night Riots, hundreds of volunteers met in the school auditorium for training as safety officers and monitors before a party in the Castro marking what would have been Harvey Milk's 49th birthday.
